data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003's suspension boundary and SRC_008's support-chain closure have a shared mechanism with SRC_002's auxiliary defense depth: UNDECIDED nodes are exactly those whose maximal defense chains have length at most the auxiliary generation depth k, and closure along support chains is the same operation as iterating the auxiliary chain construction. Refuted if there exists a graph where the suspension boundary depth differs from the auxiliary chain depth under SRC_002 encoding.
